name: omnilab/simbad
description: Omnilab SIMBAD: an astronomical object beyond the solar system by any of its identifiers (M31, Betelgeuse, HD 39801...) - its main identifier, object type, ICRS coordinates, proper motion, parallax, radial velocity and redshift, spectral and morphological types, magnitudes and other designations - and a search by identifier or name, through the TAP service of SIMBAD (CDS, Strasbourg) in ADQL, no key needed.
